name: What types of toilets are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of toilets are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of toilets available for installation, including gravity-fed, pressure-assisted, dual-flush, and wall-mounted models. Each type offers different features in terms of water efficiency, flushing power, and aesthetics. When making a decision, consider factors like your household's water usage habits, bathroom size, and accessibility needs. For example, dual-flush toilets offer water savings, while wall-mounted units can free up floor space for easier cleaning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available toilet types include gravity-fed, pressure-assisted, dual-flush, and wall-mounted models, each with different features and benefits.
